title: Последовательность для id
verify: INSERT INTO person_discounts (person_id, pizzeria_id) SELECT person.id, pizzeria.id FROM person CROSS JOIN pizzeria WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_discounts d WHERE d.person_id = person.id AND d.pizzeria_id = pizzeria.id) ORDER BY person.id, pizzeria.id LIMIT 1 RETURNING id, discount::float8 AS discount

negative.why: последовательность не передвинута: нарушение первичного ключа
negative.sql:
CREATE SEQUENCE seq_person_discounts START 1;
ALTER TABLE person_discounts ALTER COLUMN id SET DEFAULT NEXTVAL('seq_person_discounts');

negative.why: не назначено значение по умолчанию для id
negative.sql:

SELECT SETVAL('seq_person_discounts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person_discounts) + 1, false);
